buttons.label: Yes, that is what I meant

records.proposal: The card pane, still opened only by your click, lets you step through what is waiting (each card and its diagram) with Back and Next; it asks to sit on the right beside the conversation; and your answers to Claude Code's own question tool are kept as your words, with that tool used by default and cards kept for questions where a card makes sense

The pane, opened by the owner's click, shows one waiting card at a time with its diagram, and Back and Next buttons (with hotkeys) move between them, showing 'n of m'; when it is seated inline because the terminal cannot dock it, it says in one line how to get it beside the conversation

When Claude Code's question tool returns the owner's answers, plumb logs each question, the options shown and the answer as the owner's words for the session; such an answer never confirms, rejects or changes a record

plumb's skills tell the agent to ask with Claude Code's question tool by default, and to use a card only when the answer must change the owner's records (confirm, conflict, stale link, a decision that matters) or the question needs context, consequences or a diagram to answer
